note: lettre de prorogation de Bank of America (7 septembre 2018) : délai de remise des comptes audités 2018 porté au 31 janvier 2019
quote: The Extension Letter extends the delivery date of the Company's Fiscal Year ending June 30, 2018 audited financial statements, the corresponding Compliance Certificate and copies of all management letters and other material reports submitted to Borrowers by its accountants in connection with such financial statements otherwise due under Sections 10.1.2(a), (d) and (e) of the Loan Agreement to January 31, 2019.
